text:
oncall-bot: Pager: potential tokenizer/encoding mismatch affecting Helios Health (tenant: helios-123, VPC: vpc-eu-2). Symptoms: sudden token count inflation causing billing spikes and 429s from dedicated pool. Please ack and rotate oncall. :rotating_light:

shreya: acked. I'm on it. landing in the channel now. who is on primary for dedicated pools?

matt: i’m primary for runtime today. seeing elevated per-request token counts in the telemetry stream for helios-123. weird pattern: same request payload but token_count x4.

anya: checked infra metrics — dedicated-pool-7 is hitting soft qps ceiling and returning 429s for that tenant. no node OOMs. throttles started ~10:02 UTC.

shreya: eli from Helios Ops, can you confirm any recent client-side changes? encoding/version?

eli (Helios Ops): hey — we rolled a minor client update last night that upgraded a tokenizer lib. didn't think it'd affect counts but we can revert. getting reports from our billing that token bills spiked. apologies.

matt: can you paste the package/version from your build? also sending quick check command to surface tokenization discrepancy on our side:

```
# run on a sample payload
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('helios-tokenizer.json'); print(t.encode('Patient record: DOB 1990-01-01...').tokens, len(t.encode('Patient record: DOB 1990-01-01...')) )"
```

matt: on our logs, same exact UTF-8 payload produced token_count 512 for baseline tokenizer and 2,048 for the upgraded one. looks like a double-encoding / surrogate handling bug.

anya: for immediate mitigation — recommend per-tenant soft throttle + route helios-123 to fallback compatible model instance (quantized older model) while they revert. can also enable per-tenant token transform to normalize before counting.

shreya: agreed. matt, can you prepare a routing override? saya (routing-runner) can push a per-tenant override for dedicated pool.

matt: creating temporary routing policy now — routing override for helios-123 -> model: rwd-compat-1.0 (non-tokenization-sensitive) and apply soft cap 2x usual until fix. pushing policy in 2m.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20261012-45 created: "Helios Health tokenization inflation — dedicated pool impact". Severity: sev2. Pager duty: shreya, matt, anya.

harper: tagging product/CS — we need to notify Helios about potential billing remediation. @eli (Helios Ops) can we get an ETA on rolling back your tokenizer change?

eli (Helios Ops): rolling back now. estimate 25–35 minutes for full deploy to their fleet. we'll confirm once done.

shreya: matt, status on routing override?

matt: override active at 10:10 UTC. verification logs:
```
# verify routing
curl -s "https://control-plane/redwood/routing?tenant=helios-123" | jq .policy
# response: { "policy": "override: rwd-compat-1.0", "active_at": 1697043010 }
```

matt: also added temporary token-multiplexer that clamps per-request token count to 1,200 for helios-123 to avoid billing runaway. it's a soft drop — will still allow requests but trim large tails.

anya: observed 80% reduction in 5m token emission after override. dedicated-pool-7 qps back to normal.

harper: do we want to issue a provisional credit to Helios pending postmortem? product wants to avoid surprise charges.

shreya: yes. open a billing incident and flag for customer success. matt/anya, keep telemetry for 2h and capture sample payloads.

matt: grabbing example payloads and tokenization diffs and saving to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-20261012-45/helios-samples.tar.gz

anya: raising a temporary rate limit policy so that automated clients don't retry aggressively: set retry-backoff header enforcement and 10rps cap per client-id for helios-123.

eli (Helios Ops): rollback complete. we see token counts back to baseline from our side. will monitor.

matt: re-running token diffs — baseline and new tokenizer now match. looks like the root cause was a tokenizer upgrade that introduced a UTF-16 surrogate passthrough bug.

shreya: good. next actions:
- matt: create a minimal patch checklist + test harness to catch surrogate/encoding regressions in integration tests (due EOD)
- anya: keep throttles for 30m, then remove if stable
- harper: agree on provisional credit and send customer note
- cx: schedule a brief postmortem with Helios in 48h

shreya: handing off to matt for close monitoring. oncall -> matt. i'll update the incident doc and tag for postmortem.

matt: taking it. i'll post status updates every 15m until we clear the incident.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20261012-45 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring.

shreya: thanks everyone. logging this thread into the incident doc and starting a postmortem template. if anything regresses ping @shreya immediately. :white_check_mark:

matt: note for postmortem: consider adding per-tenant token normalization hook in the control plane so tokenizer differences are isolated at ingestion.

eli (Helios Ops): thanks for the quick response — appreciate the routing override and provisional credit. we'll follow up with our release notes.

shreya: last msg before handoff — closing active paging. last check shows normal token counts and no billing spikes in the last 10 minutes.

matt: monitoring still, no anomalies. will escalate if anything pops up.
